text: 金十数据8月5日讯，当前，我国处于“七下八上”主汛期，东北、西南、西北等南北方多地反复遭遇持续性强降雨，引发洪涝、地质灾害，造成人员伤亡和房屋倒损。为深入贯彻落实习近平总书记关于防汛抗旱工作的重要指示精神，8月5日，财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨3.3亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持黑龙江、辽宁、吉林、重庆、四川、贵州、云南、陕西等8省（市）开展自然灾害应急抢险救灾工作，重点做好搜救转移安置受灾人员、排危除险等应急处置、次生灾害隐患排查整治、倒损民房修复等工作,最大限度减少灾害损失。
text_en: Jin10 Data, August 5: Currently, China is in the main flood season of "late July to early August," with continuous heavy rainfall repeatedly hitting multiple regions in the north and south, including the northeast, southwest and northwest, triggering floods and geological disasters, causing casualties and housing damage. To thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on flood and drought prevention work, on August 5, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated 330 million yuan in central natural disaster relief funds to support 8 provinces (municipalities) including Heilongjiang, Liaoning, Jilin, Chongqing, Sichuan, Guizhou, Yunnan and Shaanxi in carrying out emergency disaster relief work, with focus on search, rescue, transfer and resettlement of affected people, hazard removal and emergency response, inspection and rectification of secondary disaster risks, and repair of damaged homes, to minimize disaster losses.
